authority: The game owner proposed the Hospital code panel and explicitly confirmed both the wrong-code penalty and end-round Rescue timing in this design conversation.

confirmed_rules.rule: Every living player in Hospital may submit one Hospital-panel code attempt in the entire match. It is available during a round spent in Hospital, independently of the patient's own turn. It targets only that patient.
The correct code is the player number of the player whose secret role is Cracker (the doctor). It is not the role catalog number.

The Hospital panel contains two healing injections in total for the match. Cracker's Rescue and successful patient-panel attempts draw from this same pool. The panel does not add two more heals and each patient does not receive a separate healing pool.
A wrong code consumes that patient's sole lifetime panel attempt but consumes none of the shared healing injections. No further code attempt is available to that player.

An accepted correct code consumes that patient's lifetime attempt and reserves one available shared healing injection immediately. Queue self-Rescue for the Rescue stage at the end of that same round. Entering the code does not heal the patient immediately.

Present this as a shared Public Onboard Action, available to all secret roles subject to Hospital eligibility and its own once-per-match limit. Existing independent Role/Public action allowances still apply. This specific Hospital interaction does not reactivate other disabled actions.

owner_confirmations.question: If the patient enters the wrong Cracker number, should their only panel opportunity be spent without spending a Cracker heal?
owner_confirmations.answer: Yes; spend the patient opportunity, not a heal.

owner_confirmations.question: On a correct code, reserve one heal immediately and heal at the end-of-round Rescue stage, matching the existing order?

existing_rules_still_apply: Normal attacks resolve before Rescue. A second hit can eliminate the patient before the reserved heal resolves; Rescue cannot revive an Eliminated player.
An accepted Rescue with no healing effect still spends its reserved use. The panel does not create a refund rule.
Healing does not release detention. Existing end-round placement, medical episode, Hospital capacity and admission rules still apply.

integration_followups.detail: Reconcile the patient attempt and shared healing pool with Blackhole action-cost branching and Sync. Hospital does not branch, while Cracker may act in an A/B reality. Do not silently reset a patient attempt or duplicate the shared resource.

Define the exact round phase cutoff, simultaneous reservation handling and private feedback without publishing a player's entered code or the Cracker identity. The server must never reserve more than the available shared injections. These technical details are not additional approved gameplay powers.

implementation_boundary: Confirmed design reference only. No gameplay engine, command contract, active match, deployed ruleset tuple or historical source is changed by this record.
